description: Exact linear-rank enumerators for all endomorphisms and idempotent endomorphisms of the explicit Leibniz family, with a limiting finite-field corank law.
integrity: Original deductions from the explicitly attributed bracket model and elementary finite-field matrix enumerations; no independent external certification claimed.
limitations: The classification of all derived-one-dimensional nonnilpotent non-Lie Leibniz algebras is invoked only in odd characteristic; the fixed algebra formulas hold in characteristic two.
Finite brute-force tests do not prove the infinite family result.
Literature priority is assessed relative to inspected sources; uninspected equivalences may remain.
title: Endomorphism and retraction rank spectra of a split non-nilpotent Leibniz family
